items.question: How long does it take?
items.afterText: 01How long does it take?Most projects take 2–4 weeks, depending on page count, content readiness, and interaction complexity.
items.expandedAnswer: Most projects take 2–4 weeks, depending on page count, content readiness, and interaction complexity.

items.question: Do you build in Framer?
items.afterText: 02Do you build in Framer?Yes. I design and build polished Framer websites with responsive layouts, CMS setup, and clean interactions.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. I design and build polished Framer websites with responsive layouts, CMS setup, and clean interactions.

items.question: Is it fully responsive?
items.afterText: 03Is it fully responsive?Yes. Every page is designed and tested across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. Every page is designed and tested across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.

items.question: Can I add pages?
items.afterText: 04Can I add pages?Yes. Extra pages can be added based on your project scope, content needs, and final structure.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. Extra pages can be added based on your project scope, content needs, and final structure.

items.question: Do you support launch?
items.afterText: 05Do you support launch?Yes. I help with final checks, basic SEO setup, performance review, and publishing support.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. I help with final checks, basic SEO setup, performance review, and publishing support.

items.question: Can I edit later?
items.afterText: 06Can I edit later?Yes. The site is built with clean structure, reusable components, and easy-to-edit Framer sections.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. The site is built with clean structure, reusable components, and easy-to-edit Framer sections.

items.question: Do you include CMS?
items.afterText: 07Do you include CMS?Yes. CMS can be included for blogs, projects, updates, or repeatable content sections.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. CMS can be included for blogs, projects, updates, or repeatable content sections.

items.question: Can we add motion?
items.afterText: 08Can we add motion?Yes. Subtle motion and interactions can be added to make the site feel more polished.
items.expandedAnswer: Yes. Subtle motion and interactions can be added to make the site feel more polished.
